decisions.reason: The firm has invested and publicly committed to this app, and pandemic-related travel disruptions provide a temporary explanation for weak results, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it.

As a named, multi-model product line launched with a public announcement, PassBoard carries high visibility and sunk costs, making withdrawal less likely despite the absence of recent website updates.

Because this self-service solution aligns with the firm's announced innovation direction and its disappointing results can be attributed to temporary COVID-19 effects on air travel, management will likely continue it.
